Thanks Marissa — that looks good. A couple of clarifications from our side: 

- For trace IDs we use trace_id and parent_span_id in our logs; we'd like Redwood to echo back trace_id in a response header X-Redwood-Trace to make correlation easier.
- Token-level latency: we care about total request latency and time-per-token breakdown for hot paths (inference vs batching). If you can add X-Redwood-Latency and X-Redwood-Token-Latency headers that'd be perfect.
- On auth: we prefer API keys for now but may enable mTLS for prod.

We’ll pull together a short document with our log field names (payment_id, user_id, session_id). Priya and I will aim to send that tomorrow.

Alex

Subject: Re: Post-call recap + requested observability hooks — SDK & headers (examples)

Hi Alex / Priya — looping in Dev from the runtime team. Per Marissa's note, attaching the SDK snippet (base64 image) and sample HTTP headers below. Let me know if you want these as a client-side middleware or server-side filter.

Example request headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED-API-KEY>
- X-Redwood-Client: fintechco-service
- X-Request-Id: 9f8a7b6c (your side)
- X-Redwood-Trace: 9f8a7b6c-1 (we echo this back in responses)

Example response headers (short):
- X-Redwood-Trace: 9f8a7b6c-1
- X-Redwood-Latency: 210ms
- X-Redwood-Token-Latency: inference=150ms;kv_cache=20ms;queue=40ms
- X-Redwood-Model-Variant: rwd-7b-q4f

Embeddings/reranker guidance:
- Use the embeddings endpoint with parameter reranker=true for candidate scoring; the SDK will attach original query_id and embedding_id fields so you can join them in your downstream logs.

We can provide a small Express middleware (Node) and an OkHttp interceptor (Java) to inject Authorization and X-Request-Id and parse the response headers. If you want mTLS, we’ll provide server cert requirements.

Attached: redwood_sdk_auth_snippet.png (showing middleware example). Also adding a short gist link: https://drive.google.com/observability-spec (internal).

Next steps:
- Alex: confirm you want middleware samples or server filter.
- FintechCo: send your logging field list (payment_id, session_id, user_id).

Thanks,
